decisions.reason: The spring-balanced desk lamp's own product page and accumulated development costs create visible commitment, making near-term withdrawal unlikely despite its weaker fit with the smart-lighting direction.
As a core general interior luminaire with its own page and active model launch, its high sunk investment and centrality to the announced direction keep the probability of dropping very low.
The pendant luminaire is the publicly presented flagship of the firm's direction, so its high sunk resources and public commitment make a quick drop almost unthinkable.

Although the marine searchlight has low public visibility and weaker alignment, the sunk costs from its 2023 launch and the need to justify keeping it through 2024 keep the probability of withdrawal moderate at 20.
